pictures.name: city_on_the_hill
pictures.scene: a walled city of pale stone standing on a high ridge far off, its walls catching the first gold of morning along the bottom of the frame, the whole sky above it wide and deep and empty of cloud

pictures.name: open_gateway
pictures.scene: a great open gateway of weathered stone seen from outside, warm lamplight spilling out low across its threshold and onto the worn paving at the bottom edge, the arch above it rising into unlit dark

pictures.name: worn_threshold
pictures.scene: a broad stone threshold worn into a shallow hollow by long use, lit warm and low from one side so that every dip in the stone shows, the courtyard beyond it opening away into quiet shadow

pictures.name: ascending_stair
pictures.scene: a wide stone stairway climbing between two sheer rock walls toward a bright gap of sky, its lower steps lit gold and their worn edges sharp against the shade, the climb above them dim and unhurried

pictures.name: seat_of_judgment
pictures.scene: a single carved stone seat standing empty on a bare platform of pale rock, warm light falling across its worn arms at the lower edge, the shadowed hall behind it deep and without any detail

pictures.name: lamp_at_the_wall
pictures.scene: a small clay oil lamp burning on the top of a low stone wall, its flame steady and its light pooling gold on the stone beneath it, the great dark of the night lying open beyond the wall

pictures.name: walls_at_evening
pictures.scene: a long curve of high city wall of warm sandstone seen close from below, the last evening sun lying along its lowest courses, its upper reaches cooling into blue shadow against a darkening sky

pictures.name: bread_and_bowl
pictures.scene: a low wooden table set with a round flat loaf and a shallow clay bowl, lit warm from one side at the bottom of the frame, the room beyond falling quickly away into quiet brown darkness

pictures.name: courtyard_at_dawn
pictures.scene: a wide empty courtyard of pale flagstones with a single tall gate standing open at its far side, first daylight reaching in low across the paving, the sky above still deep and full of night

lines.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
I was glad when they said to me,
“Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
Our feet are standing in your gates,
O Jerusalem.
Jerusalem is built up
as a city united together,
where the tribes go up,
the tribes of the LORD,
as a testimony for Israel,
to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
For there the thrones of judgment stand,
the thrones of the house of David.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem:
“May those who love you prosper.
May there be peace within your walls,
and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
For the sake of my brothers and friends,
I will say, “Peace be within you.”
For the sake of the house of the LORD our God,
I will seek your prosperity.
